component.name: apkscope
component.summary: Android APK decompiler, xref engine and MCP server for AI agents

description.p: apkscope opens any Android app and shows what it really does: readable Java decompilation, an xref and API-recon engine, Gradle export, APK re-signing and a native viewer, in one small binary.
The viewer uses the desktop's X11 or Wayland stack; file dialogs go through xdg-desktop-portal. The same binary also provides a CLI and an MCP server for AI agents.
